title: Euclid
summary: Euclid of Alexandria was a Greek mathematician about whose life little is known; Proclus placed him in the time of the first Ptolemy. His Elements, in 13 books, covers plane geometry, number theory and solid geometry, starting from definitions and postulates. Probably none of its results were first proved by him, but its organization is credited to him, and it stayed at the centre of mathematical teaching for 2,000 years.

uncertainty.note: Exact birth and death years are unknown; MacTutor estimates birth about 325 BC (-324) and death about 265 BC (-264), with activity placed during the reign of Ptolemy I Soter (reigned 323–282 BCE).
